concepts.name: Action chunk
concepts.summary: The data tensor a flow-matching robot policy generates: a block of shape (H, action_dim) holding H control steps of joint commands. For a 7-DOF arm with horizon 50 it is (50, 7) — 350 numbers. It slots into x₁ exactly where an image latent sat in image generation, and everything else is unchanged: x_t = (1−t)·x₀ + t·x₁ with x₀ Gaussian noise of the same shape, and the velocity target x₁ − x₀. Because the whole chunk is refined in a single forward pass, every element is conditioned on every other, which is what produces temporal consistency across the horizon rather than fifty independent decisions.

concepts.name: VLM hidden state as conditioning
concepts.summary: In image generation the velocity field is conditioned on a text embedding: v_θ(x_t, t, text_embedding). In a VLA the same slot carries the hidden state of a vision-language model: v_θ(x_t, t, VLM_hidden_state). That hidden state has already fused three streams — camera images, the language instruction, and the robot's proprioception. The plumbing is identical to text-conditioned image generation; only the contents of the conditioning vector are richer.
